name: Gemelli Pasta with Fresh Burrata, Sun-Dried Tomato & Chile Crisp (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Twisted refined wheat gemelli pasta and creamy burrata are gentle when ordered without the spicy chili oil and tough sun-dried tomato skins.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the gemelli pasta tossed in plain butter or olive oil topped with the fresh burrata cheese, holding the sun-dried tomatoes and chili flakes.
